fact: In its 6 July 2026 country statement to the UN Global Dialogue on AI Governance, Tanzania lists, among governance frameworks it is 'developing', a National AI Strategy Framework (2026); the statement gives no adoption, body or funding.
The Citizen reported that a National AI Strategy was under development and expected to be released later in 2025, as the first National AI Forum ended on 29 July 2025.
CIPIT states Tanzania is currently developing its National AI Strategy and lacks a dedicated AI law; the document gives no event date, so its publication date of 2026-09-15 is used.

Nipashe reports that the Ministry of Communication and Information Technology is implementing the National AI Strategy 2025-2030. Parent: no approval or launch is stated, so this answers question 1 only.
Communication and IT minister Jerry Silaa says the government is finalising its National AI Strategy, as UNESCO handed over the national AI readiness assessment report.
UNESCO reports that stakeholders at World Press Freedom Day 2025 in Arusha gave recommendations for Tanzania's draft National Artificial Intelligence Strategy.
Parliamentary committee chair Fatuma Toufiq said at an MPs' AI training in Dodoma that Tanzania has no AI policy yet, and MPs called for one.
